entry.summary: No visa: the Antarctic Treaty area south of 60°S. Australian citizens and organisations going there need environmental authorisation from the Australian Antarctic Division before departure, usually held by the tour operator.

layers.process: Australian citizens or organisations travelling south of 60°S need authorisation under the Antarctic Treaty (Environment Protection) Act 1980 before departure; tour operators normally hold it and submit an environmental impact assessment. Protected-area management plans apply to tourists too.
